note: Descriptions are the book's defining sentences, lightly trimmed.

disciplines.name: Command
disciplines.description: Covers leadership, negotiation, coordinating and motivating others, personal discipline, and resisting coercion, along with a variety of other social skills.

disciplines.name: Conn
disciplines.description: About spacecraft and the practicalities of living and working in space: plotting courses, piloting, operating vehicles, spacefaring traditions and protocols, and how spatial phenomena affect travel.

disciplines.name: Engineering
disciplines.description: About technology: designing, building, maintaining, understanding, and operating it, and making sure it produces the desired results.

disciplines.name: Security
disciplines.description: About safety, protection, and survival, but most importantly about violence: watching for it, understanding it, defending against it, and employing it.

disciplines.name: Science
disciplines.description: The pursuit and application of knowledge, from advanced mathematics, subspace theory, and temporal mechanics to anthropology and sociology.

disciplines.name: Medicine
disciplines.description: A distinct discipline alongside Science, less about knowledge and more about the result: healing those who are injured or sick.
